base_formula: F(x1,x2,x3) = x1 AND x2; x3 free
interpretation: Both routes give the same SAT output but carry different exact lineage, prime products, hashes, and path shapes.
Plain existential SAT can choose either route; it does not force simultaneous route support.
A paired construction that contains both fixed routes remains equisatisfiable with F.
A false lineage merge inside that paired formula creates an actual CNF contradiction.
Projection of the correct wrapper variables recovers exactly F=x1 AND x2.
The test proves formula-internal merge forcing for the paired toy construction, not a P-vs-NP lower bound.
